name: pstore_ramoops

storage.rationale: This safeguard contributes kernel parameters to the shared /etc/default/grub file owned by crashkernel-reserve; declaring that file twice would double-count it.

description: Reserve a RAM-backed pstore region for kernel oops/panic capture across resets (GRUB-editing fallback when native pstore is unavailable)

linux.reason: Host safeguards mutate host state and cannot ship in a desktop bundle.

macos.reason: Host safeguards mutate host state and cannot ship in a desktop bundle.
